fields.statement: A ship-change run that failed at ci-triage (reached from pr-green's or rebased-green's on.fail) is retried with `rhiza run resume --retry`. Today the retry restarts at ci-triage, which reads the stale state and fails again. The accepted change set 01M6XX4R8 (retry-reopens-at-wait, not built yet) will reopen a retry at the wait step whose on.pass is the failed step, but ci-triage has no such wait. Where should a retry of a run that failed at ci-triage restart?
